cues: Why are the maxima of a grating so sharp?
Watch the pattern as the number of slits grows.
Two slits give broad cos squared fringes.
Twenty, and the bright lines are needle thin.
text: Why are the maxima of a grating so sharp? Watch the pattern as the number of slits grows. Two slits give broad cos squared fringes. Five slits sharpen them. Twenty, and the bright lines are needle thin.
